name: bada-cinevim
description: Bada CineVim — a cinematic VIM editor for the Bada quantum programming language. Real modal editing (motions, operators, registers, undo, dot-repeat, :%s///), Bada syntax highlighting, a movie extreme close-up focus that magnifies the pointed line while the rest falls out of depth of field, a crash effect that lifts the pointed line in 3D with screen shake, chromatic aberration, shockwaves and shards, an Academy-leader movie countdown, and a quantum Bada runtime (qubit / H / CNOT / measure). Self-contained HTML app, zero dependencies, fully offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
